message:
## Summary
Enable comprehensive Snowflake extension support by adding two focused changes to liquibase-standard:

• **Root-level object discovery** - Enable account-level objects (Warehouses, Databases) via new `discoverRootLevelExtensionObjects()` method in DatabaseSnapshot.java
• **Namespace extension support** - Allow Snowflake-specific attributes on core change types via XSD schema extensions

## Changes Made

### 1. DatabaseSnapshot.java Enhancement
- Added `discoverRootLevelExtensionObjects()` method to enable extension objects at root database hierarchy level
- Identifies generators with empty `addsTo()` arrays as root-level (peers to Catalog)
- Enables Snowflake account-level objects: Warehouses, Databases, FileFormats

### 2. XSD Schema Extensions  
- Added `##other` namespace support to 4 core change elements:
  - `dropTable` - Enable Snowflake cascade options
  - `createSequence` - Support Snowflake sequence attributes
  - `alterSequence` - Allow Snowflake sequence modifications  
  - `dropSequence` - Enable Snowflake sequence drop options

## Impact

**Before**: Only schema-level Snowflake objects supported
**After**: Complete Snowflake functionality with account-level objects + extension attributes

**Example Usage**:
```xml
<!-- Now supported: Snowflake attributes on core types -->
<createSequence sequenceName="my_seq" startValue="1" 
    snowflake:orderBy="false" snowflake:autoSuspend="3600"/>
    
<dropTable tableName="my_table" snowflake:cascade="true"/>
```

## Test Plan
- [x] Builds successfully with clean compilation
- [x] Backward compatible - no breaking changes  
- [x] Non-functional for databases other than Snowflake
- [x] Enables complete Snowflake extension discovery and operations

## Technical Details
- **Type**: Enhancement / Extension Support
- **Scope**: liquibase-standard core module only
- **Breaking Changes**: None
- **Dependencies**: None

Both changes work together to provide complete Snowflake extension capabilities while maintaining full backward compatibility.
